in_arabic.name: فاكرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: One who is poor in material wealth but rich in spirituality, humility, and kindness.

in_urdu.name: فقرہ
in_urdu.meaning: فقر (faqr) - poverty, need, destitution; ہائی (hā'ī) - humility, meekness
in_urdu.long_meaning: A woman who is humble and meek despite being poor or destitute.

in_hindi.name: फकीरा
in_hindi.meaning: फकीर (phakīr) - poor, needy, destitute; सुखी (sukhī) - happy, content
in_hindi.long_meaning: A woman who is content and happy despite being poor or needy.

in_pashto.name: فقره
in_pashto.meaning: فقر (faqr) - poverty, need, destitution; داده (dādē) - mother, motherly
in_pashto.long_meaning: A mother who is humble and needy, yet selflessly cares for her children.
